biggest_catch: $22 per AUDIO hour, not per work hour — one audio hour typically takes ~4 hours to transcribe, so the real beginner rate is roughly $4-$6 per hour of actual work. TranscribeMe's own figures: average monthly earnings are just $250.
catches: Pay is per AUDIO hour (length of the file), not per hour worked — one hour of audio routinely takes 3-4 hours to transcribe, so effective hourly pay can be very low.
Zero guaranteed tasks: work is self-claimed from the WorkHub; availability varies.
You must pass an English entrance exam before touching any paid work — an unpaid test.
WorkHub access and exams require Google Chrome; you need a computer and stable internet (no special equipment).
The '$22' catalog figure is the TOP of the base range ($15-$22/audio hr) — most people earn at the bottom, and official average is $250/month.
Third-party sources cite a $20 PayPal payout threshold and weekly PayPal payouts — not confirmed on the official page read.

steps: Go to https://transcribeme.com/transcription-jobs and sign up for a Crowd professional account.
Register in the TranscribeMe WorkHub (requires Google Chrome on a computer with stable internet).
Pass the English entrance exam — no paid work is available until you pass.
Once approved, claim short 2-4 minute audio clips from the WorkHub queue and transcribe them (the system sends the next clip after each completion).
High-accuracy, fast transcribers can qualify for Special Teams (medical, specialty styles) at higher per-audio-hour rates.
timing: Not stated on the official page read; third-party sources report weekly PayPal payouts (could not confirm officially).
